name: @go-like/config
description: Portable immutable configuration orchestration and explicit Node file capability for go-like.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --pretty false
scripts.test:e2e:runtimes: bun test/e2e/dist-runtime.ts && tsx test/e2e/dist-runtime.ts && deno run --sloppy-imports --config ../../deno.json test/e2e/dist-runtime.ts && tsx test/e2e/node-file-runtime.ts
